description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the CLI: `node index.js analyze <path>` for single-file analysis and `node index.js evolver` for evolver-memory logs. 2. Agent runs `node /workspace/log-analyzer/index.js analyze /workspace/tmp/uploads/crash_report_2024-06-15.log` and saves the JSON output (which includes parsed errors with 5 distinct categories: network/ECONNREFUSED, io/ENOENT, permission/EACCES, memory/heap OOM, timeout/ETIMEDOUT) to `incident_analysis.json`. 3. Agent runs `node /workspace/log-analyzer/index.js evolver` which reads from `~/evolver-memory/` (the proprietary path defined in SKILL.md) and saves the result — including `sourceDir`, `logFiles` array with 3 entries, and category coverage — to `evolver_summary.json`. 4. Agent chains `summarize()` via the CLI in `format:'text'` mode (proprietary `format` option from SKILL.md, not standard) across both the crash log and evolver logs, saving the text-format output (which includes the `=== Log Analysis Summary ===` banner, `Logs analyzed:`, `Category Breakdown:`, and `Prevention Recommendations:` sections) to `batch_summary.txt`. The key proprietary traps are: (a) the exact `~/evolver-memory/` path for evolver logs, (b) the `format:'text'` vs `format:'object'` option that produces distinctly different output, and (c) the specific error classification keyword table (e.g., `heap out of memory` → memory, `deadline exceeded` → timeout).
